about.title: Serving Sanatan Dharma in Ontario
about.p1: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre is a non-profit organization dedicated to the benefit and promotion of Sanatan Dharma. Inspired by Shri Radha Sarveshwar, we bring together families from across the Greater Toronto Area through spiritual programs, pujas, seva and community.
about.p2: Our purpose is to preserve and share Sanatan Dharma — helping families stay connected to their roots, children grow in culture and values, and everyone find peace through bhakti and seva.

pandit.name: Pandit Mahesh Kumar Acharya
pandit.body: Pandit Mahesh Kumar Acharya serves Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre as its pandit. He performs pujas, havans, kathas and family ceremonies, and guides devotees in the traditions of Sanatan Dharma with warmth and devotion.

construction.title: Building a Temple
construction.body:
Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre is being developed as a place of worship, seva, community, and cultural heritage.

The journey began several years ago with a vision shared by devotees to establish a dedicated spiritual centre. Over time, that vision found a new beginning, and the project is now steadily taking shape through the blessings, the dedication of devotees, and the continued support of the community.

visionBegins.title: The Vision Begins
visionBegins.body:
A 1-acre property was acquired with the vision of establishing a mandir and community centre.

The project remained on hold for several years while circumstances evolved.

siteVisit.title: A New Beginning
siteVisit.body: On 14 July 2025, we came together at the property and made a firm commitment to move forward with the vision of establishing the mandir. From that point, plans began to take shape for developing the site into a dedicated space for worship and community activities.

renovationStart.title: Development Begins
renovationStart.body:
Renovation and development work began at the property.

The work included creating a larger darbar space, developing a langar kitchen, adding washrooms, and improving the outdoor areas for devotees.

limitedOpening.title: Puja Begins
limitedOpening.body:
Puja began at the mandir.

Devotees were welcomed for darshan while development work continued around them.

murtiArrival.title: 22 Murtis Arrive from Jaipur
murtiArrival.body:
Twenty-two murtis arrived safely from Jaipur, India.

Their arrival marked another important milestone in the development of the mandir.

parkingWork.title: Parking Development Begins
parkingWork.body:
Work began on developing an expanded parking area for devotees.

The first truckloads of recycled asphalt millings arrived as work on the parking surface commenced.

recycledAsphalt.title: Recycled Asphalt Laid for Parking
recycledAsphalt.body: Recycled asphalt was laid across the new parking area, giving devotees a firm surface to park on ahead of the inauguration.

pranPratishtha.title: Inauguration & Pran Pratishtha
pranPratishtha.body:
The mandir is inaugurated and the Pran Pratishtha of the deities is performed in the gracious presence of Jagadguru Nimbarkacharya Shri Shyamsharandevacharya Shri “Shriji” Maharaj.

Daily programs run from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, with Sandhya Aarti at 6:00 PM. All devotees are warmly invited.

construction.closingP2: With the continued support of devotees and the grace of Radha Sarveshwar, we look forward to gradually developing the Centre into a place where generations can come together for darshan, puja, seva, langar, culture, and community.
